description: Agent Water Records: submit backflow test records under a utility’s cross-connection control with the assembly, repair and tester certification records they answer to: the reading moment; each backflow assembly the cross-connection record lists with its id, reference, the service connection, the assembly type and the moment installed; each test report with its id, reference, the assembly, the tester, the result (pass or fail), the moment tested and the moment the next test is due; each repair or replacement entry with its id, reference, the assembly and the moment repaired; each tester certification record with its id, reference, the tester and the moment it lapses. The signed report gives the tests and the records behind them, each test report against an assembly the record lists, each failed test against a repair and a passing retest after it, each tester against a certification current on the day tested, and each test due against a later test of its assembly, and counts them, and names divergent water backflow records: a test report for an assembly the cross-connection record does not list, a failed test with no repair and passing retest after it, a test run by a tester with no current certification, and a backflow test due with none recorded; then a listed assembly with no test report and a test dated before its assembly was installed, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No test reports, or no tester certification records beside named testers, leaves those points unverified. Assemblies, tests and repairs match by letters and digits, so BF-0117 and BF 0117 are one assembly, testers by certification reference or name, dates by the day, a certification is current through the day it lapses, and a test due after the reading moment waits. This reads whether every backflow assembly on the utility’s cross-connection record is tested on time by a certified tester and every failure is repaired and retested. Verdict water_backflow_record_divergent, water_backflow_record_partial, water_backflow_record_unverified or water_backflow_record_consistent. POST /api/water-backflow-record-check. Reads the water records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no system, takes no sample, contacts no regulator, customer or other utility and issues no certification, approval or water right decision, which stay with the utility, its operators and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Water Records reads records held by a water utility or water system operator: water system records with operator certifications, water quality test records from the sampling chain to the results, treatment plant records, discharge monitoring records, meter records, backflow test records and well records, and a water right’s own record, whoever holds it, each against the facility, certification, connection and survey records, the sampling plan, holding times and limits, the operating log, chemical stock and calibrations, the outfalls, discharge limits and monitoring reports, the reading history, the assembly, repair and tester records, the registration, construction and closure records, or the diversions and reported use on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the water system: what the system record lists, what the sampling chain and the treatment log support, what the discharge, meter and backflow records show, and whether the well and water right records hold up; it reads by record holder, not by the water itself: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s irrigation and water-use records against its allocation, the Agent Energy family reads utility bills and tariffs, and the Agent Waste and Recycling Records family reads waste manifests and disposal records, while this family reads the utility’s, the operator’s and the right’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-water-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-water-records/.
